source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SHRINKING (GENERAL) — ATOMIC (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL
note: Atomic Shrinking. power. At Shrinking 20, permits passage between atoms, taking at least a full turn and potentially longer for large objects. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SPEED (MOVEMENT) (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SUMMON (CONTROL) (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SWIMMING (MOVEMENT) (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: TELEPORT (MOVEMENT) (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL
note: Teleport. power. Instantly moves the user and up to 50 lbs. of extra mass to a known or accurately sensed destination within rank-based range. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: TELEPORT (MOVEMENT) — PORTAL (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL
note: Teleport Portal. power. Opens a 5-foot gateway between two points that transports anyone stepping through while the user concentrates to maintain it. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: TRANSFORM (CONTROL) (mm3e-srd#003); licence OGL

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Variable (General) (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Weaken (Attack) (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Weaken. power. Temporarily reduces one chosen trait after a close attack and failed resistance check. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Accurate (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Accurate. other. Adds +2 per rank to attack checks made with the modified effect, subject to power-level limits. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Affects Corporeal (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Affects Corporeal. other. Lets an incorporeal user affect corporeal targets at a rank limited by this modifier. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Affects Insubstantial (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Affects Insubstantial. other. Lets an effect work against insubstantial targets at half rank or full rank, depending on modifier rank. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Affects Objects (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Affects Objects. other. Lets a Fortitude-resisted effect work on objects, which receive no resistance check under this rule. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Affects Others (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Affects Others. other. Grants another person use of a personal effect, which the user can later withdraw. [verb law: transfer] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Alternate Effect (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Alternate Effect. other. Swaps a power to a thematically related configuration that cannot operate alongside other alternatives in its array. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Dynamic Alternate Effect (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Dynamic Alternate Effect. other. Lets alternate effects share a point pool and operate together at reduced strength, with allocations changed once per turn. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Alternate Resistance (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Alternate Resistance. other. Changes which defense resists an effect while leaving its difficulty class unchanged. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Area (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Area. other. Makes an effect fill a selected shape and lets targets use Dodge to reduce or, for perception areas, avoid its effect. [verb add; also needs formation-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Attack (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Attack. other. Turns a personal effect into a close-range attack that affects a creature or up to 50 pounds of inanimate mass. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Contagious (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Contagious. other. Spreads an effect from its target to anyone who contacts that target, with each new target resisting normally. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Dimensional (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Dimensional. other. Lets an effect reach one other dimension, a related group, or any dimension, according to its rank. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Extended Range (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Extended Range. other. Doubles all range categories for each rank of the modifier. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Homing (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Homing. other. Gives a missed ranged attack further chances to hit by tracking its target with the original attack’s sense. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Impervious (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Impervious. other. Ignores effects whose resistance difficulty modifier is no greater than half its rank, rounded up. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Increased Duration (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Increased Duration. other. Makes an instant effect maintainable through concentration or makes a sustained effect continuous. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Increased Mass (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Increased Mass. other. Raises by one mass rank per modifier rank the amount an effect can carry or move. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Increased Range (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Increased Range. other. Extends a close effect to ranged, or a ranged effect to perception range. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Incurable (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Incurable. other. Prevents Healing or Regeneration from undoing the effect’s damage, except when the healing effect is Persistent. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Indirect (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Indirect. other. Allows a ranged effect to originate away from the user, with higher ranks allowing more choice of origin and direction. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Innate (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Innate. other. Makes an effect an essential part of the user’s nature and immune to Nullify. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: Modifiers — Insidious (mm3e-srd#004); licence OGL
note: Insidious. other. Makes an effect’s consequences harder for its target to detect, though a DC 20 skill check or unusual sense can reveal them. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: ALTERNATE FORM (mm3e-srd#005); licence OGL
note: Alternate Form. power. The user changes into a non-flesh form and gains a chosen set of associated effects; assuming the form takes a move or standard action, reducing the effect total by 1 or 2 points respectively. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: BLAST (mm3e-srd#005); licence OGL
note: Blast. power. The user makes a ranged attack against Dodge, dealing damage equal to its rank if it hits, resisted by Toughness. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: DAZZLE (mm3e-srd#005); licence OGL
note: Dazzle. power. A ranged effect impairs, disables, or makes one chosen sense unaware according to failure degrees; the target checks again at each turn’s end to recover, and repeated applications to that sense accumulate. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: DUPLICATION (mm3e-srd#005); licence OGL
note: Duplication. power. The user creates a helpful duplicate with the user’s traits, except for Duplication and victory points; rank equal to the user’s other character points divided by 15, rounded up, gives a full duplicate, while lower ranks make a reduced version. The duplicate vanishes if the power is countered or switched off. [verb law: summon] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: ELEMENT CONTROL (mm3e-srd#005); licence OGL
note: Element Control. power. The user moves a chosen element at a Strength and mass rank equal to the power rank, with alternate effects or power stunts extending its uses. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: ENERGY ABSORPTION (mm3e-srd#005); licence OGL
note: Energy Absorption. power. When struck by a chosen energy type, the user gains up to the lower of the attack rank or power rank in a chosen trait; the gain then loses 1 rank per turn, and further matching attacks can restore it up to the power’s rank limit. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: ENERGY AURA (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Energy Aura. power. Damages anyone who touches the user or is touched by them, and can be switched on or off freely. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: ENERGY CONTROL (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Energy Control. power. Projects a ranged blast of a chosen energy type and can be expanded with separately acquired alternate effects. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: FORCE FIELD (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Force Field. power. Surrounds the user with a sustained field that increases Toughness by the power’s rank. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: INVISIBILITY (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Invisibility. power. Conceals the user from normal vision for 4 points, or from all visual senses for 8 points. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: MAGIC (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Magic. power. Provides ranged magical damage and can include distinct spells such as bindings, dispelling, concealment, remote sensing, or teleportation. [verb add; also needs conceal-or-sense, containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: MENTAL BLAST (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Mental Blast. power. Deals ranged damage resisted by Will, and does not affect targets immune to Will-resisted effects. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: MIMIC (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Mimic. power. Scans a perceived character with a move action and copies a bounded number of that character’s traits. [verb copy] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: MIND CONTROL (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Mind Control. power. Escalates a target from dazed to compelled and ultimately controlled as resistance failures accumulate. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: POWER-LIFTING (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Power-Lifting. power. Raises lifting and carrying capacity without increasing strength damage or other strength effects. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SHAPESHIFT (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Shapeshift. power. Transforms the user into forms whose physical traits fit within a pool of 5 character points per rank, without granting new mental traits. [verb transform; also needs body-form] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SLEEP (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Sleep. power. Causes failed targets to progress from fatigue to exhaustion and then sleep; the effect is not normally cumulative. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SNARE (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Snare. power. Restrains a target, progressing from hindered and vulnerable to defenseless and immobilized, with no further stage beyond that. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: STRIKE (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Strike. power. Adds close-combat damage or substitutes for the user’s normal strength damage. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SUFFOCATION (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Suffocation. power. Makes a target progress from dazed to stunned to incapacitated as it becomes unable to breathe. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: SUPER-SPEED (mm3e-srd#006); licence OGL
note: Super-Speed. power. Combines enhanced initiative, quickness, and ground speed equal in rank to the power. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: How old is the character? (mm3e-srd#007); licence OGL
note: Immunity to Aging. power. Prevents aging, allowing a character to be effectively immortal and potentially thousands of years old. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: COSTUME (mm3e-srd#007); licence OGL
note: Costume immunity to the wearer’s powers. other. A costume ordinarily avoids routine damage from its wearer’s powers, though outside attacks or circumstances can still damage it. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: FUN WITH STRENGTH (mm3e-srd#007); licence OGL
note: Impervious Toughness. power. At 12 ranks, prevents most conventional weapons from requiring a resistance check, though an exploding shell can penetrate. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Mutants & Masterminds 3e SRD: MAKING THE MOST OF ADVANTAGES (mm3e-srd#007); licence OGL
note: Power Attack. feat-or-talent. An advantage identified as useful for increasing damage against slow, tough opponents. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)
